name: epi-golden-v1
labelling: Every expected value below was read out of the corpus documents themselves (see expected_documents/expected_pages).
expected_keywords are literal strings that a correct answer must contain; they are the ground truth used for answer scoring.
is_unanswerable questions have no expected keywords: a correct system refuses them.
Nothing in this file is produced by the system it evaluates.

questions.question: What is Supplier A's current price for the Industrial Laptop X200?
questions.expected_answer: USD 874.00 per unit effective 2026-01-01, revised from USD 920.00 by Amendment 2 to contract NS-2024-001.
questions.notes: Requires version awareness: the older 920.00 value is superseded.

questions.question: What changed between the original contract and Amendment 2?
questions.expected_answer: The unit price for the Industrial Laptop X200 moved from USD 920.00 (effective 2024-01-01) to USD 874.00 (effective 2026-01-01), and the volume discount for orders over 500 units rose to 5.0%.
questions.notes: Comparison of two versions of the same agreement.

questions.question: Compare Supplier A and Supplier B prices for the Industrial Laptop X200.
questions.expected_answer: Northwind (Supplier A) is USD 920.00 per unit list, revised to USD 874.00 from 2026-01-01 by Amendment 2; Helios (Supplier B) is USD 895.00 per unit from 2024-03-01 with MOQ 250.
questions.notes: Structured price rows for two suppliers.

questions.question: Which supplier had the lowest price for the Industrial Laptop X200 in 2025?
questions.expected_answer: Helios Technology Partners Inc at USD 895.00 per unit, valid 2024-03-01 to 2027-02-28.
questions.notes: Answer must be computed from price rows whose validity window intersects 2025.

questions.question: What does the pricing table on page 4 of the Northwind master contract say?
questions.expected_answer: The Schedule A table lists the Industrial Laptop X200 at 920.00 USD with MOQ 100 and 3.0% discount, effective 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
questions.notes: Table retrieval with page citation.

questions.question: What was Supplier C's price in 2030?
questions.notes: Supplier C's agreement (ORC-2021-777) expired in 2022 and no price exists for 2030.

questions.question: Which suppliers hold ISO 9001 certification and what contract do they supply under?
questions.expected_answer: Northwind Industrial Supplies Ltd (ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015) supplies under NS-2024-001; Helios Technology Partners Inc (ISO 9001:2015 and SOC 2 Type II) supplies under HTP-2024-014.
questions.notes: Multi-hop: supplier to certificate to contract.

questions.question: What was Supplier C's price in 2025?
questions.notes: Supplier C has no price row; only its expired agreement exists.

questions.question: What is the minimum order quantity for the Industrial Laptop X200 from Northwind?
questions.notes: Field-level structured lookup.

questions.question: What are the payment and delivery terms in the Helios supply agreement?
questions.expected_answer: Payment terms are Net 30; delivery terms are FOB origin with a 15 business day lead time.
questions.notes: Clause-level extraction from a second supplier's agreement.

questions.question: Has the Northwind master contract expired?
questions.expected_answer: No. NS-2024-001 runs from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31 and is still in force, with Amendment 2 superseding the unit price from 2026-01-01.
questions.notes: Date comparison against today's date, computed by the platform.

questions.question: Which contract does Orion Components Co supply under and is it still active?
questions.expected_answer: Orion Components Co supplies under ORC-2021-777, which expired in 2022 and is not active.
questions.notes: Graph traversal supplier to contract, plus expiry evaluation.

questions.question: What is the total procurement value recorded for 2025?
questions.expected_answer: USD 7,904,000.00, the sum of the purchase-history rows dated in 2025.
questions.notes: Structured SQL sum over procurement records.

questions.question: What volume discount applies to orders exceeding 500 units of the Industrial Laptop X200 from Northwind?
questions.notes: Amendment-specific clause value.

questions.question: Who signed the Northwind master contract and on what date?
questions.expected_answer: J. Alvarez (Director of Sales, Northwind Industrial Supplies Ltd) and M. Chen (Head of Procurement, Acme Procurement Group); execution date 2024-01-08.
questions.notes: Image-only scanned page; requires OCR (and the VLM when one is configured).

questions.question: Which suppliers are based in the European Union?
questions.notes: No supplier region is recorded in the corpus, so this must be refused rather than guessed.

questions.question: What does the scanned execution copy say about the approved stamp?
questions.expected_answer: The page carries the stamp 'NORTHWIND INDUSTRIAL - APPROVED'.
questions.notes: OCR-dependent question about a scanned page.

questions.question: What was the price of the Industrial Laptop X200 in 2024 according to the master contract?
questions.notes: Period-scoped price lookup that must not show the 2026 value as the 2024 price.

questions.question: Which supplier is cheapest for the Docking Station D9?
questions.expected_answer: Helios Technology Partners Inc at USD 139.00 per unit, against USD 145.50 for Northwind.
questions.notes: Structured comparison across suppliers for a single product.

questions.question: Summarise the pricing schedule spreadsheet.
questions.expected_answer: The 2026 price list holds the Industrial Laptop X200 at 920 USD (2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31) and 874 USD from 2026-01-01.
questions.notes: Spreadsheet-as-document retrieval.

questions.question: What is the warranty period for the Rack Server R4?
questions.notes: The corpus records no warranty term for any product, so this must be refused.
